policy: A Release static-analysis log may contain only these reviewed warnings. Application-source warnings are not allowlisted; MLX tensor isolation remains governed until MLXArray gains checked Sendable semantics.

allowedWarnings.reason: The completion tensor remains inside the single-owner generation domain and is materialized before product publication.
allowedWarnings.removalCondition: Remove when the completion type returns a checked Sendable materialized value or MLXArray gains checked immutable sendability.

allowedWarnings.messageContains: type 'MLXArray' does not conform to the 'Sendable' protocol
allowedWarnings.reason: Qwen3 tensor mutation is serialized by the model generation gate and request-owned isolation domain.
allowedWarnings.removalCondition: Remove when MLXArray gains checked immutable sendability or tensor results no longer cross the isolated generation helper boundary.

allowedWarnings.reason: Reference audio is immutable request input captured by the same model-owned isolation domain for one generation.
allowedWarnings.removalCondition: Remove when reference audio is materialized into a checked Sendable value before the isolated generation helper is created.

allowedWarnings.reason: Returned tensors remain generation-owned and are evaluated/materialized before leaving the runtime facade.
allowedWarnings.removalCondition: Remove when generation helpers return checked Sendable materialized audio instead of MLXArray.

allowedWarnings.reason: Resolved Swift packages contain intentionally empty platform shim objects on iOS arm64.
allowedWarnings.removalCondition: Remove when the pinned dependency graph no longer emits empty non-iOS shim objects.

allowedWarnings.messageContains: Metadata extraction skipped. No AppIntents.framework dependency found.
allowedWarnings.reason: Vocello exposes no App Intents and therefore has no AppIntents.framework metadata to extract.
allowedWarnings.removalCondition: Remove if the target adopts App Intents or Xcode stops emitting an informational warning when the framework is absent.
